translation: E ⟨eram⟩ desdenosos na terra desejável, não ⟨estavam⟩ créditos ⟨em⟩ ⟨o⟩ ⟨p⟩alavra ⟨de⟩ ⟨ele⟩

notes.subject: ⟨estavam⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks the copula/verb 'to be' required in Portuguese for grammatical completeness.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Portuguese preposition 'em' required for the verb 'crer' (to believe); the Hebrew root אמן implies trust/faith.

notes.subject: ⟨o⟩
notes.rationale: Portuguese requires the definite article 'o' before 'palavra'.

notes.subject: ⟨p⟩alavra
notes.rationale: Initial 'p' in lowercase per the word 'palavra' as translated.

notes.subject: ⟨de⟩ ⟨ele⟩
notes.rationale: The pronominal suffix -וֹ (his) is rendered as the prepositional phrase 'de ele' in Portuguese.
